author: blibber
quote:
Buggy mess on launch, no ability to do the one thing this game is named for, no physical copy, high price for the base edition, and a subscription for just the single player aspect with no online?
0/10. Unplayable.

author: blibber
quote:
A modern take take on an all time classic, this game retains the charm of the original while making significant changes to the mechanics to both familiarize new fans and challenge old fans.

10/10.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
